parsed.answer: This has been reported before as terminal#18719 (the ticket you reference), along with terminal#15689 and terminal#8683. All describe Windows Terminal crashing the whole window, and every tab's processes with it, when a tab is dragged. The archived tickets contain no fix or confirmed workaround. In #18719 the Event Viewer showed a crash in Windows.UI.Xaml.dll with exception code 0xc000027b, a stowed exception. #15689 showed the same code. The team asked reporters for crash dumps. To help, enable automatic crash dump capture (see the Terminal wiki page 'Troubleshooting Tips'), reproduce the crash, then send the dump privately to the maintainers rather than posting it publicly, since it contains buffer contents. Also add your Event Viewer details (Application Error, event 1000) to #18719 or a new ticket. Until a fix exists, avoid dragging tabs, especially near the taskbar or across monitors, and don't drag them into the client area. Reordering tabs is the safest option when you need to move one.
